cues.heading: Get comfortable
cues.text: Lie on your back with your exercise leg straight.

cues.heading: Slide your heel in
cues.text: Slide your heel towards your bottom, bending your knee.

cues.heading: Keep contact
cues.text: Keep your heel on the bed. Move within your comfortable range.

cues.heading: Slide back out
cues.text: Slowly slide your heel away until your leg is straight again.

cues.heading: One complete movement
cues.text: Keep your hips still. Do not force the bend or push through sharp pain.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Use the range and repetitions your physiotherapist has prescribed.
